content.title: Where to watch USA vs. Belgium men’s soccer friendly tonight on free streams, TV
content.text: Updated: Mar. 28, 2026, 12:45 p.m.Published: Mar. 28, 2026, 12:43 p.m.United States' Gio Reyna (7) celebrates his goal during the first half of an international friendly soccer match against Paraguay, Saturday, Nov. 15, 2025, in Chester, Pa. (AP Photo/Derik Hamilton)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe United States Men’s National Team continues its World Cup tune-up Saturday in Atlanta with an international friendly against Belgium. The game is scheduled to start at 3:30 p.m. ET with TV coverage on TNT and streaming on-demand.How to watch USA vs. Belgium on TV and stream without cable:When: Saturday, March 28 at 3:30 p.m. ETWhere: Mercedes-Benz Stadium, Atlanta, Ga.TV channel: TNT and truTVStreaming on: DirecTV (free trial) | SlingTV (low intro rate) | HBO ($19.99+/mo.) | Peacock ($10.99/mo.)USA vs. Belgium: The matchupBelgium is a slight betting favorite (+125) on American soil facing an American team with growing intrigue and expectations for results in the 2026 World Cup. The Americans have a total of four more friendlies left on their schedule before pool play begins in the World Cup on June 12, with Portugal (March 31), Senegal (May 31) and Germany (June 6) all lined up for dates in the U.S. Team USA is 4-1-1 in friendly competition since falling to Mexico (2-1) in the Concacaf Gold Cup final, with its only loss since coming in its first exhibition against South Korea (2-0). The Americans are riding a five-match unbeaten streak into Saturday’s contest against Belgium, most recently a dominant 5-1 victory over Uruguay in November.
